title: Hosted Rollouts (Canary % Workflow) — GA Release Checklist
body:
Last updated: 2024-11-08 (Connor O'Brien)

Purpose
- This checklist is the runbook for flipping Hosted canary rollouts workflow from beta/flagged to GA.
- Covers: gating toggles, staged rollout by region/account, monitoring verification, comms, rollback criteria, and sign-offs.

Scope (GA)
- Console workflow (create/edit rollout, schedule steps, guardrails, preview effective routing, pause/rollback, audit timeline)
- Control-plane rollout policy v2 schema + validation + migration path from beta
- Hosted data-plane routing: weighted splits + sticky routing option
- Streaming/session semantics: pin variant selection, stable retries
- Telemetry: per-variant metrics + cardinality controls + dashboards/alerts
- Security: audit events for rollout changes + export compatibility
- Docs/support readiness

Not in scope for GA (explicit)
- Full A/B experimentation features beyond canary % split (future theme)
- Automated “promote candidate” / “auto-advance” beyond the current timed stepper
- Mandatory quality gates for all customers (optional gate only; no hard dependency)


0) Owners + release channel
Release driver: Connor O'Brien (Eng Release)
PM owner: Marissa Cole
PM (policies/telemetry): Paula Mendes
Console eng: Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin
Control plane: Ethan Park / Jordan Lee
Routing: Mina Haddad / Ravi Menon
Telemetry: Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman
SRE: Sean Gallagher / Allison Grant
Security: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei
Support readiness: Dev Patel / Owen Phillips

Primary comms channels
- #eng-releases (coordination + status)
- #eng-platform, #eng-sre, #eng-security (escalations)
- #support (support enablement + FAQs)


1) GA prerequisites (must be done before any external enablement)
[ ] All GA-blocking Linear issues closed OR explicitly waived w/ owner + rationale (attach links)
    - PM-641 milestone “Phase 3 GA” complete
    - ENG-8421/8422/8423/8424/8425/8426/8428/8429/8430 complete

[ ] Code merged to release branch + deployed to all Hosted regions
    - Control plane + console backend + routing + telemetry + audit logging
    - Confirm rollout policy propagation monotonic version fix is live (ref: PR 18537)

[ ] Backward compatibility validated for beta users
    - Existing beta rollout objects can be read/edited in Console GA flow
    - Any one-time migration (if applicable) has a rollback plan (schema version pin)

[ ] RBAC + Entitlements are enforced and tested end-to-end
    - Permissions (create/edit/pause/rollback/view audit) work as expected
    - Correct error messages surfaced in Console (no “unknown error”)
    - No elevation paths via API (direct call bypass)

[ ] Audit logging enabled in all regions and in at least one SIEM export test
    - Event types: rollout.create, rollout.update, rollout.pause, rollout.rollback
    - Payloads: actor attribution, route id, before/after diff, timestamp, request id
    - Confirm PII constraints (no prompts/content; only config and IDs)

[ ] SLO dashboards + alerts installed and verified in prod
    - Control-plane evaluation latency/availability
    - Policy propagation staleness
    - Per-variant error rate / latency / token cost delta

[ ] Runbook verified by oncall (dry run)
    - Hosted rollout pause/rollback steps
    - Verification panels + expected propagation times

[ ] Docs PR merged and published plan confirmed
    - docs: Hosted rollouts GA page + guardrails + monitoring + rollback
    - troubleshooting section includes common misconfigs + “expected behavior”


2) Feature gating toggles (inventory + intended GA state)
Note: names below match internal usage; verify actual flag keys in config repo before flipping.

2.1 Control plane
[ ] rollout_policy_v2_enabled = ON (all prod regions)
[ ] rollout_policy_validation_strict = ON (GA validation rules)
[ ] rollout_policy_preview_endpoint = ON (effective routing preview)
[ ] rollout_policy_migration_read_beta = ON (temporary; for beta compatibility)
[ ] rollout_policy_migration_write_v2_only = ON (no new beta writes)

2.2 Console
[ ] console_rollouts_ga_ui_enabled = ON (staged, see section 3)
[ ] console_rollouts_ga_wizard_enabled = ON
[ ] console_rollouts_audit_timeline_enabled = ON
[ ] console_rollouts_guardrails_ui_enabled = ON

2.3 Routing / data plane (Hosted)
[ ] hosted_weighted_variants_enabled = ON
[ ] hosted_rollouts_sticky_routing_enabled = ON (default OFF in UI; capability ON)
[ ] hosted_streaming_variant_pinning_enabled = ON

2.4 Telemetry / metrics
[ ] canary_variant_metric_tags_enabled = ON
[ ] canary_metric_cardinality_guardrails_enabled = ON
[ ] canary_compare_dashboards_enabled = ON

2.5 Entitlements
[ ] entitlement_hosted_rollouts_ga = ON for internal + beta cohort
[ ] entitlement_hosted_rollouts_ga = OFF for all other accounts until Phase 2/3

2.6 Kill switches (must exist and be documented)
[ ] kill_switch_disable_rollouts_create_update = READY
[ ] kill_switch_force_all_baseline = READY (force 0% candidate)
[ ] kill_switch_disable_sticky_routing = READY
[ ] kill_switch_disable_variant_metric_tags = READY (cardinality emergency)


3) Staged rollout plan (prod enablement)
Goal: reduce blast radius and ensure monitoring signal is clean.

Phase A — internal dogfood (24–48h)
[ ] Enable entitlement_hosted_rollouts_ga for Redwood internal accounts only
[ ] Enable console_rollouts_ga_ui_enabled for internal org(s) only
[ ] Create 2–3 test routes with known traffic patterns (one streaming-heavy)
[ ] Run scripted canary steps: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 0% (rollback)
[ ] Validate:
    - sticky routing behavior (on/off)
    - retries keep same variant on streaming
    - audit timeline shows correct diffs and actors
    - preview endpoint matches observed routing

Exit criteria Phase A
[ ] No P0/P1 incidents
[ ] Dashboards show expected per-variant splits (within statistical variance)
[ ] No metric cardinality alarms triggered

Phase B — limited external beta cohort (3–7 days)
[ ] Enable entitlement_hosted_rollouts_ga for approved beta accounts (list maintained by PM/CS)
[ ] Turn on Console GA UI for those accounts
[ ] Provide beta cohort with monitoring + rollback guidance (support packet)

Exit criteria Phase B
[ ] At least 5 customer rollouts created and monitored successfully
[ ] At least 2 controlled rollbacks executed without support escalation
[ ] No sustained increase in routing-related errors or unexpected splits

Phase C — GA launch (broad enablement)
[ ] Enable entitlement_hosted_rollouts_ga for all eligible plans/tiers
[ ] Remove/retire beta-only gating docs, keep backwards compatibility read path for 1 release cycle
[ ] Confirm region-by-region enablement order (if applicable): us-east -> us-west -> eu-central -> ap-southeast


4) Monitoring verification (must be checked during Phase A and at GA)
Baseline: pick 1 internal route and 1 external beta route as “canaries of the canary” for validation.

4.1 Control plane / policy
[ ] Policy evaluation p95 latency within SLO
[ ] Policy evaluation error rate within SLO
[ ] Propagation staleness within SLO in all regions
[ ] No increase in config write failures post-enable

4.2 Routing correctness
[ ] Effective split matches configured weights (allow small variance)
[ ] Sticky routing: distribution stable per key, no cross-variant flapping
[ ] Streaming: single request does not mix variants; retries preserve selection

4.3 Variant health deltas
[ ] Error-rate delta baseline vs candidate within guardrail thresholds (where configured)
[ ] Latency delta baseline vs candidate within guardrail thresholds
[ ] Token cost delta baseline vs candidate within guardrail thresholds

4.4 Telemetry/cardinality
[ ] Variant dimension does not blow up series counts (confirm cardinality panels)
[ ] Sampling rules behaving as expected on high-QPS routes

4.5 Console workflow health
[ ] Rollout create/update/pause/rollback endpoints have acceptable latency
[ ] Audit timeline loads; events appear within expected delay
[ ] Preview endpoint returns deterministic results for identical inputs


5) Rollback criteria + actions (define before GA)
We will rollback (or pause enablement) if any of the following occur:

P0 rollback criteria (immediate)
- Routing sends >configured % to candidate for any route (systemic bug)
- Policy propagation staleness causes inconsistent splits across regions for >5 min in a way that impacts customers
- Elevated 5xx attributable to routing/rollout evaluation across multiple tenants
- Streaming variant mixing observed in prod
- Telemetry cardinality incident requiring emergency reduction

P1 rollback criteria (within same business day)
- Console workflow cannot reliably pause/rollback due to API or persistence errors
- Audit logs missing for critical actions or show incorrect actor attribution
- Guardrail enforcement failures (e.g., configured thresholds ignored)

Rollback actions (order of operations)
1) Flip kill_switch_disable_rollouts_create_update = ON (stop new changes)
2) Flip kill_switch_force_all_baseline = ON (force baseline traffic)
3) Optionally disable hosted_weighted_variants_enabled (only if necessary; coordinate with routing)
4) Disable console_rollouts_ga_ui_enabled (hide GA UI to prevent confusion)
5) Communicate status in #eng-releases, #support, and customer-facing status page if impact warrants
6) Open incident + assign owner for root cause + remediation timeline

Post-rollback verification
[ ] Confirm per-route weights effectively baseline-only
[ ] Confirm error/latency return to pre-incident baseline
[ ] Confirm no stuck rollouts in “running” state without ability to edit


6) Comms plan (internal + external)
Internal (required)
[ ] Announce Phase A start + end in #eng-releases
[ ] Announce Phase B customer cohort list + dates in #support and #customer-success
[ ] Provide support FAQ + escalation path (owner on-call rotation)
[ ] Add “what changed” note to weekly eng update (1 paragraph)

External (GA day)
[ ] Publish docs updates (Docs lead sign-off)
[ ] Publish release notes entry (Product + Docs)
[ ] If any customer-visible migration note is required: include UI banner or doc note
[ ] Sales enablement note for common questions (sticky routing, guardrails, audit logs)

Customer messaging constraints
- Be explicit: guardrails are configurable; not all are mandatory
- Be explicit: sticky routing is optional and has tradeoffs
- Provide monitoring “starter” dashboards + what to watch first 24h


7) Required sign-offs (go/no-go)
Sign-off is required before moving from Phase B to Phase C (broad GA enablement).

Product
[ ] Marissa Cole — Feature meets GA acceptance criteria; customer messaging approved
[ ] Paula Mendes — Guardrails/telemetry scope acceptable for GA

Engineering
[ ] Dylan Brooks — Console UX/workflow ready; error states acceptable
[ ] Ethan Park — Control-plane policy schema + validation + migration risk acceptable
[ ] Mina Haddad — Routing integration ready; stickiness + streaming semantics validated
[ ] Logan Wright — Telemetry/metrics pipeline validated; cardinality controls in place

SRE/Operations
[ ] Sean Gallagher — SLOs/alerts in place; oncall procedures verified
[ ] Allison Grant — Dashboards + alert routing verified; runbook linked in alerts

Security/Compliance
[ ] Marcus Lin — Audit logging and access controls acceptable for GA
[ ] Kevin Osei — Audit event payload review complete; export considerations addressed

Support readiness
[ ] Dev Patel — Support macros/FAQ ready; escalation path confirmed

Release
[ ] Connor O'Brien — Checklist complete; final flag flip plan approved


8) Open items / notes (fill in during execution)
- Beta cohort accounts enabled:
  - (add account ids + owner)
- Known risks accepted:
  - (add list)
- Launch date/time window (avoid peak traffic):
  - Proposed: Tue/Wed 10:00–12:00 PT
- On-call assignments during GA week:
  - Platform:
  - Routing:
  - Console:
  - Telemetry:

Appendix A — Quick links for responders
- Runbook: Hosted rollout pause/rollback (Confluence)
- Dashboard: Canary compare (baseline vs candidate)
- Dashboard: Policy propagation staleness
- Audit log viewer query template (internal)

Appendix B — Standard test rollout (copy/paste)
Route: /v1/chat/completions (staging first, then internal prod route)
Baseline: model X @ version A
Candidate: model X @ version B
Steps: 1% (30 min) -> 5% (30 min) -> 25% (60 min) -> pause -> rollback to 0%
Guardrails:
- error_rate_delta <= +0.25% absolute (5m window)
- p95_latency_delta <= +150ms (5m window)
- token_cost_delta <= +10% (15m window)
Sticky routing: OFF initially; turn ON for second pass
Streaming test: include streaming= true requests with forced retry
